name: Irondeep Supplies
label: Quest
description: Irondeep Supplies: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Before the fighting started, we stored supplies for Dun Baldar in the Irondeep mine. The troggs that surfaced there weren't much of a problem when we had spare troops to guard the mine, but now that we're fighting with the Horde we can't maintain control of Irondeep.
We need the supplies in Irondeep, friend. Enter the mine and bring me a load of them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the supplies, friend? We can never have enough!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done! I'll put these supplies to good use! Thanks, friend!
